name: io.github.James-Chahwan/repo-graph
description: Structural graph map of any codebase so LLMs navigate by structure, not guesswork.

packageArguments.name: --repo
packageArguments.description: Path to the target repository to map. Defaults to the working directory the client launches the server in.

environmentVariables.name: REPO_GRAPH_REPO
environmentVariables.description: Path to the target repository to map. Alternative to --repo; takes effect when --repo is not passed.
